title: AI jo code likh ke computer chalata hai
content:
Ye AI mouse nahi chala raha...
ye CODE likh ke computer chala raha hai.

Alibaba ki Tongyi MAI-UI team ne OpenGCUA open source kiya hai.
It is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
Ye ek computer-use agent stack hai.

Pehle samjho problem kya thi.
Computer-use agent ka matlab hai ek AI jo aapke computer pe khud kaam kare.
Apps kholna, forms bharna, files move karna.
Purane computer-use agents screenshot lete the, click karte the... phir screenshot, phir click.
Har chhota step ek alag turn.
That is slow, and it is expensive.

OpenGCUA ka idea simple hai.
Model ek Python program likhta hai.
Usme GUI clicks bhi hain, app APIs bhi, shell commands bhi... loops aur conditions ke saath.
And the model decides when it actually needs to look at the screen.

Par asli twist numbers mein hai.

Team ne aath frontier models test kiye.
OSWorld-v2 pe average score 45.3 se 64.9 ho gaya.
That is plus 19.6 points.
Aur steps per task average 53 percent KAM ho gaye.

Sabse interesting baat... weaker models ko sabse zyada fayda hua.
GLM-5.3-Flash got 35.2 points better.
Matlab sahi harness, model jitna hi important hai.
A smaller, cheaper model with a smart setup can close a big part of the gap.
Aur ye baat har builder ko yaad rakhni chahiye.

Ab reality check.
Ye results team ke apne hain.
Mac harness aur SDK abhi preliminary hain.
So treat it as a research preview, not a finished product.

Builder ke liye lesson kya hai?
Agent se har kaam screen pe click karke mat karwao.
Jahan API hai, API use karo. Jahan nahi hai, wahan GUI.
Maan lo aapko har hafte ek app se report nikaal ke sheet mein daalni hai.
Agent API se data le, aur sirf zaroori jagah click kare.
Fast bhi, sasta bhi, aur galti ke chances bhi kam.
Clients ke liye automation banate waqt yahi soch sabse kaam aati hai.

Comment GCUA and I'll DM you the GitHub link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
